notes: Fiscal year ended December 27, 2025 (FY2025 Form 10-K, accession 0000050863-26-000011). Capex is gross additions to PP&E, not netted against 1,577 of capital-related government incentives. Capex excludes 3,026 of PP&E additions paid to capital vendors under extended payment terms (over 90 days), which Intel reports in financing activities (1,178 in 2024); including them would raise paidOut to 60.828. Intel reports no separate intangible-purchase line. Interest and taxes paid are inside operating cash flow (US GAAP); income taxes paid now come from the income-tax note. Divestiture proceeds (6,157 net) are investing and excluded.
